view.summary: A bullet-hell shooter: steer an Evangelion through enemy barrages, shoot down Raptures and giant “Mimicry” bosses, and raise A.T. Field with the damage you deal. Stars and materials from each stage upgrade your parts.

overview.title: The game
items: 2025-02-19 16:00 to 2025-03-12 19:59; new stages opened day by day
Drag anywhere on the screen to move; the Evangelion and its extra weapon shoot on their own
Only hits on the cockpit count
Dealing damage charges it; when full you can use it. Each Evangelion’s A.T. Field works differently
Base score for kills plus a collection score for the score items enemies drop
1 star for clearing a stage, 2 and 3 stars for reaching its score targets

pages.title: Movement Tutorial
pages.text: Tap and drag anywhere on the screen to move the Evangelion.

pages.title: Damage Detection
pages.text: The pilot will be at risk if the Evangelion's cockpit takes direct hits.

pages.title: Use A.T. Field
pages.text:
Dealing damage to the enemy will recharge energy. Once fully charged, the A.T. Field can be used.
The effects of the A.T. Field vary depending on the type of Evangelion.

overview.title: Materials
rows: High-performance components salvaged from the battlefield that are immensely powerful. Deliver to the Mighty Tool Squad to enhance combat performance.
